draft_en.subject: A DIN-rail switch SKU for your industrial category
draft_en.body:
Buongiorno,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 31 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the networking items your electrical-trade customers pick up with their cabinets and panels: a DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP unmanaged switch, -40 to 75 C, redundant DC input, CE/RoHS, neutral packing - model STI-280GE - $46 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); the 8 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP version, STI-288GP, $57.4.

One question: would a DIN-rail switch SKU fit your industrial category, or do your customers source networking elsewhere?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
